📖 How to use

      
  1. Type two hexadecimal numbers.
  2. Choose add or subtract.
  3. Press Calculate to see the hex result with decimal and binary checks.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How does hex addition work?
Same as decimal column addition, but each digit carries at 16 instead of 10: F + 1 = 10₁₆.
Can the result be negative?
Yes — subtraction can go below zero, shown with a minus sign in every base.
Is the 0x prefix allowed?
Yes, a leading 0x is stripped automatically; digits may be upper or lower case.
